With the controller's checks at their defaults, 73 of the 75 runs of nearly_independent on structures 0 to 4 were stopped, every one by the growing-error check, and all 148 of its runs at the defaults with the checks widened completed. (The held-back count on the 6 x 6 system, 14 of 15 stopped, was seen by mistake before this was written.)

The published form of nearly_independent differs from the law as built by no more than 0.3 dB in median error at the held-out gauges on either system at any stage (6 x 12: +0.02, +0.00 and -0.01 dB; 6 x 6: +0.21, +0.28 and +0.07 dB), and runs 0.4 to 0.5 dB higher in level on the 6 x 6 system.

The open form of nearly_independent has a higher error at the held-out gauges than the closed loop on the 6 x 6 system at every stage (+1.07, +1.26 and +1.07 dB) and a higher stress error (+2.18, +3.44 and +1.35 dB); on the 6 x 12 system the difference at the held-out gauges is +0.29 dB on linear structures and inside 0.2 dB at the other two stages.
The tuned setting of nearly_independent (the weighting off) is within 0.2 dB of the defaults in median error at the held-out gauges on both systems at every stage.
